items.hook: World War II: The Canadian declaration of war on Germany receives royal assent.
items.body: A declaration of war by Canada against Germany was made by order-in-council signed by George VI, King of Canada, on 10 September 1939, seven days after the United Kingdom and France had also entered a state of war with the Nazi regime. One of those things you can't un-know.

items.hook: Vade retro satana, is a medieval Western Christian formula for exorcism, recorded in a 1415 manuscript found in the Benedictine Metten Abbey in Bavaria; its origin is traditionally associated with the Benedictines.
items.body: The initials of this formula have often been engraved around crucifixes or the Saint Benedict Medals of Western Christianity since at least 1780. Bring it up somewhere. Watch the reaction.
